dropped.item: Customer outreach was described as 'targeted'; the edit says only 'outreach'
Online items were framed as 'investment in' site performance, fulfillment, and so on; the edit says 'work on', which weakens the explicit link to spending money

changed.item: 'Mall traffic is structurally declining' became 'declining for good reasons we can't reverse'. 'Structural' means long-term, not cyclical. The edit adds more certainty ('can't reverse') and a judgment ('good reasons') that weren't in the original.
'Consolidating lets us concentrate talent and inventory' became 'put our talent and inventory in one place'. This is inaccurate because the plan has two destinations, the Denver flagship and online.
